author: reek
body: A class with a superclass carries the superclass's dictionary.

author: reek
body: synth-class-type-defs gives SortableDict a field __super-Equatable of type EquatableDict. Nothing used to put a value in it: the instance dictionary was built from the instance's own methods alone, so the field was left to __alloc, which zero-fills. Every superclass dictionary of every instance of every class that had one was a null pointer.

author: reek
body: It stayed invisible because the two halves of the bug cancelled. The PARSE keep-deck copy dropped ClassDef.superclass on the floor, so the desugarer saw no superclass, never added the field to the record, and never missed it. Repairing the copy left the field present and empty.

author: reek
body: This chapter used to name Equatable as a superclass without declaring it anywhere, and the dangling reference resolved to nothing and bothered no one -- which is what an erased constraint buys you. Equatable is declared here now, with an instance for Integer, so the constraint is real.

author: reek
body: Reach through the Sortable dictionary into the superclass dictionary it now carries, and call the superclass method out of it. A zeroed __super-Equatable is a null pointer, and this is the line that finds out.
